notes.title: Update Note: 20 August 2025
notes.content:
Added a map and mini-map system, which include icons for objectives, Player and some NPC's, health and magic powerups.
Fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Major Update 09 August 2025
notes.content: [p]-Added a Prelude scene "Morningside Night" to set the tone for the events to follow. Players get to play as the White Werewolf at the beginning of the game :)[/p][p]-Fixed an issue with the player jumping into any trigger volume that disables movement, where the player gets stuck in the air. [/p][p]-Added a few more visual cues like glow and question marks to help guide the player to items of interest.[/p][p]-Added 2 more save points in 'Mount Atrium' level[/p][p]-Fixed Red Glide and bounce off character, where she then used to get launched higher in the level.[/p][p]-Fixed Reds controls menu and tips when learning the end scene abilities.[/p][p]-Added Red's Stats info when switching to Bo-Peep. Previously only had Bo-Peeps stats while playing as Red.[/p]

notes.title: Update Note: 04 March 2025
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue in Scene6 where the guards where searching for Red before the objective started, which could have resulted in a failed objective in error.
-Fixed Bo-Peep's crook getting stuck in mid-air on sheep, pig and old lady.
-Fixed a few rock assets that were not properly positioned on the ground.

notes.title: Update Note: 01 March 2025
notes.content: -Fixed a blocking volume in the first level, which previously allowed the player to go past and trigger the Wolf attack Owl part, before learning the attack ability.
